latin_text: What it may be for the waters under the heavens to be gathered together into one place would perhaps be doubtful if it were not explained to us by Paul, in whom we read that the angels sent to carryon the duties of this world are all guardian spirits sent to minister to those who receive the inheritance of salvation. From this we can understand that these subcelestial waters, that is, the angelic armies, have been assembled into one place to look after the good and salvation of man alone.

exegesis:
[VERIFIED] Pico interprets "waters gathered together into one place" (Gen. 1:9) as the unification of all subcelestial angelic armies in a single cosmic purpose: human salvation. [VERIFIED] Citing Hebrews 1:14 ("all angels are ministering spirits sent to serve those who will inherit salvation"), Pico establishes that the lowest angelic order's raison d'être is human welfare and redemptive ascent.

The philosophical function is soteriological-mystical: the entire lower angelic hierarchy is constituted for human service. This grounds both prayer and mysticism: the guardian angels are genuinely present, actively invested in human spiritual progress. [INFERRED] Ascending means cooperating with and ultimately participating in this angelic ministry to one's own soul.

[VERIFIED] Oration (O.1.13) develops this soteriological function: angels descend to announce divine peace enabling human ascent. Being & Unity grounds it: the entire created hierarchy serves participated being's reception of divine grace.
